text:
maria_sales: Quick RFP follow-up for FinTechCo POC. They need: 1) Confirmation we can keep all processing in APAC for the POC, 2) Full subprocessor list for APAC, 3) BYOK options and price delta. Can we give a concise customer-facing summary?

alex_presales: I can write it. Quick question: do they require tenant-level pinning (single-tenant in ap-northeast-1) or just prefer routing affinity? They ticked both on the sheet.

maria_sales: They explicitly said no cross-border processing for PII during the POC. So tenant pinning preferred. Also asked if BYOK is possible without Dedicated.

josh_engops: For a POC we can enable TenantPin to ap-northeast-1 which keeps compute + EBS in region. Control-plane calls (management, billing) still come from our hosted control plane unless we deploy Private. BYOK requires Dedicated or Private to connect customer KMS; otherwise we use Redwood KMS and can provide key custody attestation.

claire_security: Important: pinned tenant doesn't automatically remove observability/monitoring subprocessors. In APAC we use AWS ap-northeast-1 for compute/storage, Cloudflare for edge and WAF, Datadog for metrics. Datadog ingestion can be restricted to regional endpoints for the POC. I'll prepare a short subprocessor blurb.

sam_legal: We can provide the subprocessor list. We'll redact contact emails. If they need DPA amendments for APAC subprocessors that impacts timelines (~10 business days). Also note: subpoenas & legal process clause still applies per our contracts.

alex_presales: Draft one-pager bullets for customer: 
- Tenant pinning: compute + storage stay in chosen region (ap-northeast-1)
- Control plane: management signals routed from Redwood control plane unless Private is chosen
- Subprocessors: attached list (networking, infra, monitoring)
- BYOK: available with Dedicated/Private; attestation available otherwise
- Routing enforcement: POC mode can set deny_cross_region=true to block egress; this requires engineering config and SOW
- Fallback behavior: for a POC we propose fail (do not auto-fallback) unless customer signs off

josh_engops: Slight tweak: don't promise global fallback in POC. If deny_cross_region=true we should set fallback_policy: "fail". If customer wants soft fallback we can do prefer-region then failover with audit. Example routing policy snippet we can include: ```
priority: ["ap-northeast-1"]
route_on_region: true
deny_cross_region: true
fallback_policy: "fail"
```

maria_sales: They also want a simple diagram that shows no egress outside APAC. Can eng-ops produce that?

josh_engops: Yes. I can produce a minimal diagram + JSON policy for the POC. First-pass in 48h. To fully enforce end-to-end (telemetry, support agents, backups) we need 5 business days and an SOW.

claire_security: I'll confirm Datadog ingestion endpoints and whether we can side-step US-based collectors. Also checking Cloudflare logs retention and whether any logs go to other regions by default.

sam_legal: Add a paragraph about subprocessors' roles and contractual commitments. We should also call out what we consider "processing" vs "control signals".

alex_presales: OK I'll assemble the one-pager + subprocessor table + routing snippet + ask for BYOK option and Dedicated quote delta. Maria, want me to include the SOW/timebox note?

maria_sales: Yes include: 48h for network diagram + subprocessor list (non-redacted) and 5 business days + SOW for full enforcement. Customer expectation management is key.

ops-bot: Reminder: eng-ops oncall is josh_engops for 48h.

josh_engops: FYI: to enforce deny_cross_region end-to-end we need to configure VPC routing, control traffic allowlists, and reconfigure Datadog to regional endpoints. I'll list specific tasks in the SOW.

claire_security: Also suggest an encrypted-in-transit note & KMS key residency for the POC. I'll provide the minimal language for their security team.

maria_sales: Great, I'll send a short reply to FinTechCo stating we can pin the POC to APAC with strict routing controls, will send diagram + subprocessor list in 48h, and include BYOK pricing delta. Thanks all.

alex_presales: Dropping a short customer-ready summary in #sales-drafts for review in ~30m.

maria_sales: Perfect.
